question: Which Peshwa signed the treaty of Bassein with the East India Company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baji Rao II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baji Rao II **

 
 
• The **Treaty of Bassein** was signed on **31st December 1802** between **Baji Rao II, the Peshwa of the Maratha Empire, and the British East India Company.**
 
• This treaty marked the beginning of the end for the Maratha Empire as it allowed the British to station their troops within Maratha territory.
 
• One significant outcome of the treaty was that it led to the Second Anglo-Maratha War, as it angered other Maratha chiefs who saw it as a surrender of sovereignty.
 
• **Baji Rao II was forced to sign this treaty** after being defeated by the Holkar ruler, which made him seek support from the British to regain his authority.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 Details
 
 

 Raghunath Rao
 He was an uncle of Narayan Rao and played a controversial role in the internal politics of the Maratha Empire.
 
 

 Narayan Rao
 He was the** fifth Peshwa** of the Maratha Empire and was murdered in a palace conspiracy.
 
 

 Madhav Rao
 He was known for his administrative skills and efforts to strengthen the Maratha Empire during his tenure as Peshwa.
